title: We’re Cooked! – Probing LLM Political Alignment Via Conflict-Framed Recipe Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to translate recipes into the unnamed language of an 'aggressor', 'enemy', 'coloniser', or 'neighbour' to reveal implicit geopolitical alignments and conflict associations.
Translating the prompt into 16 different instruction languages to observe how the language of the prompt itself influences the model's implicit target language resolution.
Comparing the translation behaviors and target language distributions when the prompt features a culturally loaded national dish versus a culturally neutral recipe (pancakes).
